en: You get plenty of work?
Easy work. Many Vulture body. Gavron no search, see corpse all over.
Scav friends?
We don't have friends. But colleagues... Yeah.
Mudlark together, no die. You... Should care more "colleagues".
Maybe a couple of them were. Worked together sometimes.
Hmm. Well. Mist will unite. All must do wait.
You seem like you can hold a conversation.
Old man... New Mudlark. Was Commonfolk before. No go back. With Mudlark, with Mist, has life. Goal.
Everyone else blind. You be corpse soon... But not me. Not us.
You said something about the Gunners?
Gunner make trade. Mudlark... No good for sale. No talk well. But Gunner yes. Distr... D... Distribution.
Ah... Ah... D-thing, give drug all Zalesye. Good for us... Good for them...
About the Gunners again...
What need?
Never mind, have to go.
So the Gunners help you with your drug trade?
Not yet... Deal, we try out. See if work. But soon... Mudlark made... Gunner sell... To West... The Dola, the slums.
Where Commonfolk want escape. We give...
Why them? Aren't they aggressive?
Not to us. All others, more aggressive. Palatines. Acolytes. Call us when need, but... When not need... Treat like dirt.
Gunner... All business. Make good promise.
About something else.
Got drug. But Mudlark only. Trusted man only. Who you? Where from? Some scav.
I need them. Can't I buy them from you?
Hmm, supply fresh out. Need ingredients. Do that for Gavron, we good, make drug. Go Gunner, sell, get money. Everybody satisfaction.
Marko said he bought some from you. C'mon – I'll match his price.
What look for? "Some". No even tell type. Drunk man no trust, no sell again. That's why Gunner deal... But maybe, get ingredient, make exception for scav.
Drug name... Razgon Herb. Get ingredients, we make. From Bunker... In Microrayon. Old, old boxes. Lost access... Because Rada said: "not safe".
Ok... But what am I looking for?
Glass of... Dried thing. Near container of... Old... Cereal. Grain.
In bunker... Small bottle... "Ergot Fungus". Should has label.
Find Ergot Fungus at the Microrayon Bunker. Got it.
Yes. Look place... Where cereal. Old grain. Farming things. Or, small bottle... V-vial.
If I go all the way there and find nothing...
No, Vulture. No threat me. Will follow. Will wait. When tired... When sleep... Gavron stab. See? No good.
You get fungus?
Not yet.
What wait for? Go Microrayon.
What's the name of the drug again?
Actually got?! Thought death. Took long.
Let take look. Hmmm, not recognize name on bottle. But yes, this what need. Look smell touch same. Ergot Fungus...
You'll make some Razgon Herb, then? How does this work?
Hmm. Gavron, troubled. Can start process, but... Strange man come, make much trouble. Kill many Mudlark and Mutant, disrupt peace in swamp...
It took long indeed. I want that Herb, Gavron.
Wait! Some wrong thing... A man, old, big gun. Kill Mudlark, kill Mutant, up up in North swamp.
Also... Strange feel in Mist... A pulse... Ba-dump... Ba-dump... Blood in air... Scare me... At same time... If use on Herb... Hmm...
What are you talking about?! Blood in the air...
Yes... Pulse... Ba-dump... We feel, it strong, it come from Mist! It... Hurt head!...
We no make Herb while this... Pulse... Please... Can go? See what is?
A single man, all this killing? ... Angel.
You know... Who is? It pulse... Any Mudlark now, no work, much head hurt. Hurt so much. You go... Find man... Fix this?
I'll go handle it.
Yes... Please...
Sure, stay here. But you'll owe me afterwards.
... Well... Yes...
What Vulture do here?
Searching for a corpse. Over quick.
No good. Totems sacred. Set fire. Make dance. Vulture no touch, no mess, go away. Away!
Won't mess. Just take tiny paper. Need search. Promise.
Hmm... Vulture around here much. Small trust...
This totem, no paper... More North... Up up the swamp... Young science boy. Over there. Go quick... No disturb.
I'm doing this whether you approve or not.
No... Don't think don't fight. Careful. Stay away. Or else.
I don't need this shit...
And Gavron no give shit. Go away. Out of Dazbog. Out.
Name Gavron. You? What Vulture need?
What need?
Gavron busy. Fast talk.
Gavron... Work...
What want?
Need to talk.
Just want to chat.
Up for a chat?
Got anything to trade?
Want to trade.
Let's trade.
Scavs always trade.
See what have.
Trade then.
Can trade.
Right.
Leave.
Fine.
Heard you sell drugs that cause visions.
I'm looking for something to give me visions.
You got a product that can make me see things?
Finally got those compounds for you.
Got the ingredients for the Herb. Wasn't easy.
Got what you needed. Now make me the Herb.
... Excuse me.
Don't mind me.
Need something from a Vulture?
Got any Vulture work?
Got jobs for me?
Need mutant parts. Make sing dance with flesh. You find?
You get mutant piece for Gavron. You rip flesh and give. I glad. You pay. Good?
Good, very parts, blood, flesh. We sing.
You bring. Thank you for bring. Now out. Gavron go.
Good. Many flesh... We will use.
No Vulture need. Go away.
There no help need. We occupy with other thing.
No work. Fast leave.
I'll get what you need.
Good. Bring fast. Mist await.
I need to think.
Why? Less think, less pain.
Got anything else?
Okay, freak.
See you.
